output.title: Route53 deletion fix: Route53 usage not shown in environment
output.content: The change fixes not-found error detection when cert-manager deletes AWS Route53 DNS records, which only matters for DNS-01 challenges solved through Route53. The environment summary shows only a Certificate (cert-manager.io/v1), a Deployment, and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer, so it doesn't say whether a Route53 DNS-01 solver is configured. The missing piece is the issuer definitions. If any use a route53 solver, this bugfix applies to challenge cleanup, and no values key shown relates to it.
